components.title: Deduplicate and filter orders
components.what: Remove exact duplicate rows by order_id and all fields, then retain only shipped or pending orders.

components.title: Calculate revenue by customer
components.what: Compute each retained order's revenue as units × unit_price and sum by customer. The highest customer is C101 with 16874.23; total revenue is 88583.57.

components.title: Calculate the percentage
components.what: Compute 16874.23 ÷ 88583.57 × 100 = 19.0489%, rounded to one decimal place: 19.0%.
